info.name: SRD 5.1: Warlock
info.description: The warlock class with its SRD subclass.
info.author: dndbuilder contributors (SRD 5.1 content by Wizards of the Coast, CC-BY-4.0)

description.p: Warlocks are seekers of the knowledge that lies hidden in the fabric of the multiverse. Through pacts with mysterious beings of supernatural power, they unlock magical effects both subtle and spectacular.

Hit Dice: 1d8 per warlock level. Proficiencies: light armor, simple weapons. Saving throws: Wisdom, Charisma. Skills: choose two from Arcana, Deception, History, Intimidation, Investigation, Nature and Religion.

setters.set: A wielder of magic derived from a bargain with an extraplanar entity.

description.p: Your arcane research and the magic bestowed on you by your patron have given you facility with spells. All your warlock spell slots are the same level and are regained on a short or long rest. Charisma is your spellcasting ability.

In your study of occult lore, you have unearthed eldritch invocations, fragments of forbidden knowledge that imbue you with an abiding magical ability. You learn two at 2nd level and more as you gain levels. When you gain a level, you can replace one invocation you know.
Your otherworldly patron bestows a gift upon you for your loyal service.
Increase one ability score by 2 or two ability scores by 1 (maximum 20), or take a feat if your game uses feats.

Your patron bestows upon you a magical secret called an arcanum. Choose one 6th-level spell from the warlock spell list. You can cast it once without expending a spell slot, and regain the ability on a long rest.

description.p: At 1st level you strike a bargain with an otherworldly being of your choice.

The Fiend lets you choose from an expanded list of spells when you learn a warlock spell: burning hands, command, blindness/deafness, scorching ray, fireball, stinking cloud, fire shield, wall of fire, flame strike and hallow.
When you reduce a hostile creature to 0 hit points, you gain temporary hit points equal to your Charisma modifier + your warlock level (minimum 1).

sheet.description: Gain {{dark ones blessing:hp}} temporary hit points when you reduce a hostile creature to 0 hit points.

description.p: When you make an ability check or a saving throw, you can add a d10 to your roll, after seeing the roll but before the outcome. Once per short or long rest.

sheet.description: Add a d10 to an ability check or saving throw.

description.p: Choose one damage type when you finish a short or long rest. You gain resistance to that damage type until you choose a different one. Damage from magical weapons or silver weapons ignores this resistance.

When you hit a creature with an attack, you can instantly transport it through the lower planes. It disappears and hurtles through a nightmare landscape, returning at the end of your next turn and taking 10d10 psychic damage if it isn’t a fiend. Once per long rest.

sheet.description: On a hit, banish the target through the lower planes until the end of your next turn (10d10 psychic damage).

description.p: You have made a pact with a fiend from the lower planes of existence, a being whose aims are evil.
